description: Na₂₂S₁₀O₄₀Cl₃ crystallizes in the cubic I̅43d space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one Cl atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.45-2.94 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with three equivalent NaClO₅ octahedra and corners with four SO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 84°. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and one longer (2.30 Å) Na-O bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O and one Cl atom to form NaClO₅ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaClO₅ octahedra, corners with five SO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaClO₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-89°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.52 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.83 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaClO₅ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-52°. There is one shorter (1.48 Å) and three longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. In the second S site, S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaClO₅ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-65°. There are two shorter (1.49 Å) and two longer (1.50 Å) S-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one S atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to three Na and one S atom to form distorted ONa₃S trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ClNa₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃S trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃S trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 29-80°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one S atom. Cl is bonded to six Na atoms to form ClNa₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent ONa₃S trigonal pyramids.
